description: This file declares the interface for reflog walk operations, including initializing, releasing, adding entries, retrieving messages and identifiers, and iterating over reflog entries within a version control system.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog_walk_info structure for traversing reflog entries.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a reflog_walk_info structure.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry associated with a commit and name to the walk info.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays the reflog message with optional formatting based on date and force date flag.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the reflog message into a string buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the current reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the current reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a string summary or selector for the current reflog entry based on formatting options.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if there are no more entries in the reflog walk.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Advances to the next reflog entry in the walk.
